summary: Our website is called TrendLab. We are focusing on surface temperature. This app gives you real-time information from NASA and other multiple websites. This website lets you research about 5 different regions that will give you info with graphs, comparisons, and drops and ups of the region. Surface temperature is a big topic because the Earth’s temperature is dropping down in some places and going up in the rest. It’s unpredictable. It’s not up in the sky, but surface temperature is down at our feet and our surroundings. That’s why TrendLab is great.
details: Our project follows this simple method: first we pick a location because trends can be different in different places. This app is beneficial because it can tell us real time information and can give people updates on their environment and notice trends. The intended impact of our project is to get people to be more aware of their environment and notice bug changes. We used HTML, CSS and JavaScript. We also used ClaudeCode as a coding assistant and VS code as a platform. Our project is creative because there are many features that other apps don’t. For example, a live environmental feed that updates all the time. Helpful infographics and Earth skin options we also used creative ways to animate our information.
